crossRefs.note: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is…
He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’ ”
because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of…
I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before…
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, and your faith also is in vain.
translations.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
translations.kjv: And if Christ be ➔ not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
translations.asv: and if Christ hath not been raised, then is our preaching vain, your faith also is vain.
